status: Fixed before the first project model fit; source headers and example rows had already been inspected, so this is not a blinded preregistration

rowSelection.purpose: Exclude intra-site total-flux rows from a compact-component model; apply the same criterion to both splits

freeParameters: one constant compact flux shared across training years
one constant compact flux shared across training years

fit: Minimize diagonal weighted squared amplitude residuals over the declared grid; at each shape value fit nonnegative flux analytically using only training rows
uncertainty: Publisher RMS errors, diagonal approximation. Shared gain/calibration correlations, intrinsic variability and low-SNR non-Gaussian amplitude errors are not modeled. Criteria are project diagnostic thresholds, not a formal significance test.
holdoutPolicy: No refitting diameter, width, flux, error floor, selection or thresholds using 2013. Emit every selected holdout prediction and residual, including failures.
scientificScope: Visibility-model comparison for a simple stationary circular brightness surrogate. No GR radiative transfer, MHD, complex order-parameter, material-state, magnetic-field or observational black-hole-class validation. Emission-ring diameter is not identified with geometric shadow diameter.
